name: ベンチプレス
aliases: バーベルベンチプレス
start: lying supine on a FLAT horizontal bench, feet planted; a BARBELL just above mid-chest, elbows bent
end: same lying position; both elbows extended, barbell vertically above chest
detail: Keep the flat bench, torso, head and feet still. Both barbell plates and both hands must be visible. This is not a shoulder press.

name: ラットプルダウン
start: seated at a high-cable lat pulldown machine, thighs under pads, arms reaching up to a WIDE overhead bar
end: pulling the same bar DOWN to the upper chest with elbows beside the torso
detail: The cable stays taut and connected to the overhead pulley. The hips remain seated. Pull in front of the head, not behind the neck.

name: レッグプレス
start: reclined in a 45-degree leg-press machine; both feet on the same large sloping footplate, knees bent
end: extending the knees to push the footplate UP the diagonal rails, knees not hyperextended
detail: Keep back and hips against the reclined pad. The plate and feet travel together along the rails. Include recognizable rails and a large footplate.

name: スクワット
start: standing with a BARBELL across upper back and both feet planted shoulder width
end: lowered into a squat with hips back and down, knees bent, thighs around parallel
detail: The bar stays on the shoulders and hands remain on it. Feet stay planted. Hips and knees move naturally; do not translate a rigid standing figure.

name: 腕立て伏せ
start: high plank on palms and toes, arms extended, body aligned from head through hips to heels
end: elbows bent, chest lowered near the floor while body remains aligned
detail: Palms and toes are stationary contact points. Show actual elbow flexion, not a rigid picture moving vertically. No bench or weights.

name: ダンベルカール（左右）
aliases: ダンベルカール(左右別)
start: standing, upper arms beside torso, forearms lowered, one dumbbell in each hand at thigh level
end: bending both elbows to bring the dumbbells toward the shoulders, palms facing up
detail: Head, torso, shoulders, hips and elbows remain at consistent positions. Forearms rotate around the elbows. Dumbbells remain attached to the hands.

name: プランク
start: forearm plank supported on both forearms and toes, elbows beneath shoulders, head, spine, hips and heels aligned
end: holding the SAME aligned forearm plank posture
detail: This is an ISOMETRIC HOLD. Make one static illustration. Do not add a false repetitive bending movement, rocking, or whole-image shake. No equipment.

name: ペックフライ
start: seated upright on a pec-deck fly machine, arms opened to the sides holding the machine handles with softly bent elbows
end: bringing both handles inward to meet in front of the chest
detail: Keep the seated torso and back pad fixed. The machine arms pivot around the shoulders in a horizontal chest-hugging arc. This is not a dumbbell press.

name: チェストプレス
aliases: マシンチェストプレス
start: seated against an upright chest-press machine back pad, hands on handles at mid-chest, elbows bent
end: pushing the machine handles horizontally FORWARD by extending both elbows
detail: The seat and torso remain upright and fixed. Include the distinct machine frame and lever arms. Do not depict overhead pressing or a lying barbell bench press.

name: スミスマシン・インクラインベンチプレス
aliases: スミスマシンインクラインベンチプレス
start: lying on a clearly INCLINED 30-degree bench inside a Smith machine, guided bar near upper chest, elbows bent
end: pressing the guided bar UP along the same vertical rails, elbows extended
detail: Clearly show TWO VERTICAL Smith guide rails and an inclined back pad. The bar slides along the rails. Keep bench and torso supported and stationary.

name: ケーブルクロス
aliases: ケーブルクロスオーバー
start: standing between TWO high cable pulleys, arms opened wide holding a separate cable handle in each hand, elbows softly bent
end: bringing both hands together in front of the lower chest in a hugging arc
detail: Two taut cables remain connected to opposite upper pulleys throughout. Feet and torso stay stable. Hands do not merge into a barbell.

name: ディップス
start: supported on two parallel dip bars, arms extended, feet off the floor, slight forward torso lean
end: bending the elbows to lower the torso between the same stationary bars
detail: Hands stay planted on the parallel bars. Show actual elbow bending and shoulder movement. No bench behind the body and no pulldown cable.

name: ダンベルフライ
start: lying supine on a FLAT bench, feet planted, arms opened to the sides with a dumbbell in each hand and softly bent elbows
end: bringing the dumbbells together above the chest in a wide hugging arc
detail: Head, back, and buttocks must all rest horizontally on the FLAT bench throughout every frame. Never show a seated posture or an upright or raised torso. Keep the elbow bend almost constant. Move at the shoulders. This is a fly, NOT a press. Flat bench and torso stay fixed.

name: ダンベルプレス
aliases: ダンベルベンチプレス
start: lying supine on a FLAT horizontal bench, dumbbells beside the chest, both elbows bent
end: extending both elbows to press the two separate dumbbells above the chest
detail: Use TWO dumbbells, never a connected barbell. Keep bench and torso fixed. This is a flat bench, not an incline or upright shoulder press.

name: インクラインベンチプレス
aliases: インクラインバーベルプレス
start: lying on a clearly INCLINED 30-degree bench, a free BARBELL near upper chest, elbows bent
end: pressing the barbell above the upper chest by extending both elbows
detail: The sloping back pad must be unmistakable. Use one free barbell with plates, without Smith guide rails. Keep torso supported and feet planted.

name: デッドリフト
aliases: バーベルデッドリフト
start: hinged forward with bent knees, neutral back, both hands holding a BARBELL at shin level close to the legs
end: standing upright with the barbell held against the thighs and arms straight
detail: Feet stay planted. Hips and knees extend together. Keep a neutral spine and the bar close to the legs. Do not curl the bar with the elbows.

name: プーリーロー
aliases: シーテッドケーブルロー
start: seated at a LOW cable row station, feet on footrests, back neutral, arms reaching forward to a close-grip cable handle
end: pulling the handle toward the lower ribs by moving the elbows back beside the torso
detail: The cable stays taut and connected to the LOW front pulley. Torso remains stable with only small natural movement. No overhead pulldown bar.

name: チンニング（懸垂）
start: hanging from a fixed overhead pull-up bar with an OVERHAND shoulder-width grip, arms extended, feet off the ground
end: bending elbows and pulling the body upward until chin reaches bar height
detail: The bar and hand contact points remain stationary. Use overhand palms-away grip. This is not an underhand chin-up and there is no cable or seat.

name: ベントオーバーロー
start: standing hip hinge with torso inclined forward and knees softly bent, BARBELL hanging below the shoulders, arms extended
end: pulling the barbell toward the abdomen by bending the elbows and drawing them back
detail: Keep feet, hips and torso angle nearly fixed. The moving joints are primarily elbows and shoulders. No bench support and no seated cable machine.

name: スミスマシン・バーベルスクワット
aliases: スミスマシンバーベルスクワット
スミスマシンスクワット
start: standing inside a Smith machine with the guided BARBELL across upper back, feet planted
end: lowering into a squat with hips and knees bent as the bar slides down the rails
detail: Show TWO VERTICAL GUIDE RAILS clearly. The guided bar remains on the upper back and slides along the rails. Distinguish this from a free barbell squat.

name: レッグエクステンション
start: seated at a leg-extension machine, back against pad, knees bent about 90 degrees, roller across the FRONT of the ankles
end: straightening the knees to raise the padded roller in front of the body
detail: Hips, torso and thigh support remain fixed. The lower legs extend around the knee joints. The roller stays attached to its machine lever and in front of the shins.

name: レッグカール
aliases: ライイングレッグカール
start: lying FACE DOWN on a leg-curl machine pad, legs nearly extended, padded roller behind the ankles
end: bending both knees to bring the heels and padded roller upward toward the buttocks
detail: Chest and hips stay supported face-down. Movement happens at the knees. The pad stays behind the ankles, not in front of the shins. No leg-extension motion.

name: サイドレイズ
aliases: ダンベルサイドレイズ
ダンベルラテラルレイズ
start: standing, dumbbells beside the thighs, arms lowered and elbows softly bent
end: raising both arms OUT TO THE SIDES to shoulder height with the same small elbow bend
detail: Head and torso stay stable. Arms spread sideways, not forward. Keep each dumbbell in its respective hand. Never curl at the elbows.

name: ショルダープレス
aliases: マシンショルダープレス
start: seated upright in a shoulder-press MACHINE, hands on lever handles near shoulder height, elbows bent
end: extending both elbows to press the machine handles overhead
detail: Show an upright back pad, seat and overhead machine lever arms. Use machine handles, not free dumbbells. Keep the torso against the pad.

name: フロントレイズ
aliases: ダンベルフロントレイズ
start: standing, a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, arms lowered with a small elbow bend
end: raising both arms FORWARD to shoulder height
detail: Keep the torso, hips and feet still. Hands move forward, not out sideways. Elbow bend is nearly constant and no overhead press is performed.

name: ダンベルショルダープレス
start: seated upright on a nearly VERTICAL bench, one DUMBBELL beside each shoulder, elbows bent
end: pressing the two separate dumbbells OVERHEAD by extending both elbows
detail: The back pad is nearly vertical, not a 30-degree incline bench. Torso and hips stay seated. No machine lever arms and no connected barbell.

name: ケーブルフェイスプル
start: standing facing a cable pulley at face height, arms reaching forward holding both ends of a ROPE attachment
end: pulling the rope toward the face with elbows spread wide and hands beside the temples
detail: Keep a stable torso and stance. Show the taut cable at face height and two rope ends in separate hands. Do not pull the rope downward to the waist.

name: バーベルカール
start: standing with upper arms beside torso, holding a single BARBELL at thigh level with an underhand grip
end: bending both elbows to raise the same barbell toward the upper torso
detail: Elbows, shoulders, torso and hips remain fixed. Use one connected barbell, not separate dumbbells. Both hands stay attached to the bar.

name: アームカール
start: seated at an ARM CURL MACHINE with upper arms supported on a sloping pad, hands holding the machine lever handles, elbows almost extended
end: bending both elbows to raise the machine handles toward the shoulders
detail: Include a recognizable seat, upper-arm support pad and machine lever pivot. The upper arms remain on the pad. Do not show a standing free-weight curl.

name: ケーブルプレスダウン
aliases: トライセプスプレスダウン
ケーブルプッシュダウン
start: standing before a HIGH cable pulley, upper arms beside torso, elbows bent, hands holding a short cable bar near the lower chest
end: straightening both elbows to push the cable bar DOWN toward the thighs
detail: Keep upper arms, shoulders and torso stable. The taut cable runs UP to the pulley. No overhead shoulder press and no biceps curl.

name: アンダーグリップチンニング
start: hanging from a fixed overhead bar with an UNDERHAND palms-toward-face grip, arms extended
end: bending elbows and lifting the body until the chin reaches the bar
detail: Hands stay fixed to the same bar with a clearly underhand grip. Feet remain off the ground. Distinguish this from an overhand wide-grip pull-up.

name: 上体起こし
start: lying on the floor with knees bent and feet planted, arms lightly crossed on chest
end: raising the torso toward a seated position by curling through the abdomen
detail: Keep the feet and hips in consistent places. This uses a visibly larger torso lift than a short crunch. Do not pull on the neck.

name: ランニング
start: running in place, left leg leading and right arm forward
end: returning to the identical starting running pose after one full natural stride cycle
detail: Create 16 sequential phases of a continuous running gait, NOT the forward-and-reverse pattern. Show left/right leg alternation, knee flexion, heel lift and opposite arm swing. Keep the runner centered; the ground and camera remain still. No treadmill.

name: インクラインダンベルプレス
aliases: インクラインダンベルベンチプレス
start: lying on a clearly INCLINED 30-degree bench, two DUMBBELLS beside upper chest, elbows bent
end: extending both elbows to press the separate dumbbells above upper chest
detail: Clearly show the inclined backrest. No connected barbell, no Smith machine and no nearly upright shoulder-press bench. Torso and feet stay supported.

name: インクラインダンベルフライ
start: lying on a clearly INCLINED 30-degree bench, arms opened wide with separate dumbbells and softly bent elbows
end: bringing both dumbbells together above the upper chest in a hugging arc
detail: Keep elbow bend nearly constant and move at the shoulders. Clearly distinguish a FLY from a press. Inclined bench and torso remain stationary.

name: スミスマシン・ベンチプレス
aliases: スミスマシンベンチプレス
start: lying on a FLAT bench inside a Smith machine, guided bar just above mid-chest with elbows bent
end: pressing the guided bar UP along vertical rails until elbows extend
detail: Show TWO VERTICAL Smith guide rails and a FLAT horizontal back pad. Bar stays connected to the rails. Distinguish this from free barbell or incline pressing.

name: ワンハンドダンベルロー
aliases: ワンハンドダンベルロウ
start: one knee and the same-side hand supported on a flat bench, torso nearly horizontal, opposite arm holding ONE dumbbell hanging below shoulder
end: pulling the dumbbell toward the same-side hip by bending the working elbow and drawing it behind the torso
detail: Keep the supporting hand, knee, planted foot and torso stable. Use one working dumbbell, not two. The working elbow stays near the body.

name: Tバーロー
start: standing astride a LANDMINE T-BAR with one end anchored to the floor, hip hinge, both hands on close-grip handles near the loaded end, arms extended
end: pulling the weighted end of the T-bar toward the lower chest by bending the elbows
detail: The far end stays anchored to the same floor pivot. Show weight plates at the near end and recognizable T-bar handles. No seated cable row.

name: バックエクステンション
aliases: ハイパーエクステンション
start: supported at hips on a 45-degree Roman-chair back-extension bench, ankles secured, torso hinged downward
end: extending at the hips until torso aligns with the legs, without leaning beyond that line
detail: Keep hip pad, ankle restraints and feet fixed. Show a recognizable 45-degree back-extension bench. Do not depict lying on the floor or a lumbar backward arch.

name: リアレイズ
aliases: ベントオーバーリアレイズ
start: standing hip hinge with torso nearly horizontal, dumbbells hanging below chest, elbows softly bent
end: raising both arms OUTWARD to the sides in a reverse-fly arc
detail: Keep the hinged torso and hips stable. Move at the shoulders with nearly fixed elbow bend. This is not a standing lateral raise or a bent-over row.

name: アーノルドプレス
start: seated upright, two dumbbells held in front of the shoulders with PALMS FACING THE FACE and elbows forward
end: rotating the forearms outward while pressing the dumbbells OVERHEAD with palms facing forward
detail: Clearly show the grip rotating during the press. Keep torso and hips seated against an upright pad. Distinguish this from a conventional dumbbell shoulder press.

name: ハンマーカール
aliases: ダンベルハンマーカール
start: standing, upper arms beside torso, separate dumbbells held with a NEUTRAL thumbs-up grip near thighs
end: bending elbows to raise the dumbbells toward shoulders while KEEPING the neutral grip
detail: Heads of the dumbbells stay vertical in hammer orientation. Palms face each other throughout, not upward. Head, torso and elbows remain stable.

name: プリーチャーカール
start: seated at a PREACHER BENCH, upper arms resting on its angled pad, both hands holding a short free EZ-bar below the shoulders, elbows almost extended
end: bending elbows to curl the free EZ-bar upward while upper arms stay on the pad
detail: Show the sloping preacher pad and a free curved EZ-bar. Do not replace the bar with machine lever handles. Keep shoulders and seat fixed.

name: インクラインダンベルカール
start: seated leaning back against a clearly INCLINED 55-degree bench, upper arms hanging behind the torso line, two dumbbells lowered near the hips
end: bending both elbows to raise the dumbbells while shoulders and upper arms remain supported in the same position
detail: The inclined backrest must remain visible in EVERY frame. This is NOT a standing dumbbell curl or incline chest press. Keep head, torso and bench fixed.

name: トライセプスエクステンション
aliases: オーバーヘッドトライセプスエクステンション
start: seated upright, upper arms beside the head, both hands holding ONE dumbbell behind the head, elbows bent
end: extending both elbows to lift the dumbbell above the head without moving the upper arms
detail: Use a two-hand overhead dumbbell triceps extension. Keep torso and upper arms stable. Do not press the whole upper arms up from the shoulders.

name: ブルガリアンスクワット
aliases: ブルガリアンスプリットスクワット
start: split stance, FRONT foot planted and REAR foot elevated on a low bench behind, holding a dumbbell at each side
end: bending the front knee and lowering the hips while the rear foot remains supported on the bench
detail: Keep both foot contact points consistent. Include the unmistakable rear-foot support bench. Torso stays controlled; this is not a conventional two-foot squat or forward lunge.

name: ランジ
aliases: スプリットスクワット
start: upright in a SPLIT STANCE on the floor, one foot ahead, one behind, dumbbells held at sides
end: bending both knees to lower the rear knee near the floor, front shin roughly upright
detail: Both feet stay on the FLOOR, no rear bench. This is the stationary split-stance lunge motion used to illustrate the exercise. Keep torso upright and hands holding dumbbells.

name: ゴブレットスクワット
start: standing with feet shoulder width, holding ONE dumbbell vertically with both hands against the chest in a goblet grip
end: lowering into a squat while keeping the dumbbell close to the chest
detail: No barbell on the back and no side dumbbells. Feet stay planted. Show the single vertical dumbbell near the chest throughout.

name: ルーマニアンデッドリフト
start: standing upright, holding a BARBELL against the front of the thighs, knees softly bent
end: hinging hips BACK with only slight knee bend, neutral torso inclined forward, barbell lowered close to the shins
detail: Keep knees only slightly bent, not a deep squat. Feet remain planted, bar stays close to legs and arms stay straight. Hips and spine move as a controlled hinge.

name: ヒップスラスト
aliases: バーベルヒップスラスト
start: upper back supported against the edge of a bench, feet planted, hips lowered, padded BARBELL across the hip crease
end: extending hips upward until shoulders, hips and knees form a nearly straight horizontal line
detail: Keep upper-back and foot contact points fixed. The bar stays across the hips, not in the hands above the chest. Show actual hip extension and avoid lumbar hyperextension.

name: カーフレイズ
aliases: スタンディングカーフレイズ
start: standing upright with forefeet on the edge of a low step and heels lowered, dumbbells at sides
end: rising onto the balls of both feet by lifting both heels
detail: Forefeet stay on the step. Show ankle movement and calf contraction with a stable upright torso. This is not a knee-bending squat or a rigid floating figure.

name: ヒップアブダクション
start: seated upright in a hip-abduction machine, legs close together, pads against the OUTSIDE of the knees
end: opening both knees OUTWARD against the pads
detail: Keep the seat, torso, feet and machine frame consistent. The pads are outside the knees. Motion is opening outward, not squeezing inward.

name: ヒップアダクション
start: seated upright in a hip-adduction machine, legs opened wide, pads against the INSIDE of the knees
end: squeezing both knees INWARD together against the pads
detail: Keep the seat, torso, feet and machine frame consistent. Pads are inside the knees. Motion is closing inward, not pushing outward.

name: クランチ
start: lying on the floor, knees bent, feet planted, hands lightly crossed over chest
end: curling just the head and shoulder blades off the floor while the lower back and hips stay down
detail: Use a SHORT abdominal curl. Do not sit all the way up. Keep feet and hips fixed, and avoid pulling on the neck. Distinguish clearly from the larger sit-up motion.

name: レッグレイズ
aliases: ライイングレッグレイズ
start: lying supine on the floor, arms at sides, both legs held almost straight a short distance above the floor
end: raising both legs together toward vertical by flexing at the hips
detail: Keep head, shoulders, arms and back supported. Legs remain nearly straight and move as a pair. No hanging pull-up bar and no seated leg-extension machine.

name: 腹筋ローラー
start: kneeling on the floor, both hands on the handles of ONE small ab wheel directly in front of knees
end: rolling the wheel FORWARD as the shoulders and hips extend while knees remain planted, maintaining a controlled torso
detail: The small wheel must be unmistakable, roll along the floor and stay attached to both hands. Knees remain the same support point. Do not hyperextend the lower back.

name: ロシアンツイスト
start: seated on the floor, knees bent and heels supported, torso leaning slightly back, holding ONE weight plate with both hands to the LEFT side
end: rotating the rib cage and both hands to bring the same plate to the RIGHT side
detail: Hips and feet remain planted while the upper torso rotates. Use an actual left-to-right torso twist, not a camera pan, sideways slide or dumbbell curl.
